[Fixed: added goto_prefix='' to prevent https:// being prepended to chrome:// URLs; removed irrelevant travel site config steps]
fix_history: Fix 1: Added 'goto_prefix': '' to active_url_from_accessTree result config to prevent default 'https://' prefix from corrupting chrome:// internal URLs

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'get_active_url_from_accessTree' correctly configured with 'goto_prefix': '' to avoid prepending 'https://' to chrome:// internal URLs. The getter will return the raw address bar text 'chrome://settings' as-is.

Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly receives rules dict with 'expected': ['chrome://settings.*'] via get_rule, and uses re.search to match the URL pattern against the getter result. The regex 'chrome://settings.*' will correctly match 'chrome://settings' or any subpath.
The instruction has a single requirement (open Chrome settings page) and the evaluator fully covers it by checking the active tab URL matches the chrome://settings pattern.
Config setup appropriately launches Chrome with remote debugging and opens a starting page (google.com), providing a valid initial state for the task.
